llm.envManagedBody: LLM configuration is controlled by settings.toml and environment variables (mode=local + force_env=true). No UI configuration is needed.
llm.maxTokensHelper: Leave empty to keep the model/TOML default

llm.topKHelper: Used by Watsonx / LiteLLM when supported
llm.extraParamsHelper: Provider-agnostic map for LiteLLM / OpenAI-compatible backends. Auth keys are stripped server-side.
llm.extraParamsNotObject: Extra params must be a JSON object
llm.extraParamsNotJsonValues: Extra params must be JSON values (no functions)

knowledge.preparingBody: Getting the embedding model{{model}} ready — this can take a minute the first time. Search will work as soon as it finishes.
knowledge.unavailableLocal_one: Your {{count}} indexed document can't be searched — the active embedder{{model}} isn't usable. It runs locally, so there's no key or connection to check — its model files are missing or unreadable. Restart to let CUGA re-download them; if it persists, check free disk space and network access.{{error}}

It runs locally, so there's no key or connection to check — its model files are missing or unreadable. Restart to let CUGA re-download them; if it persists, check free disk space and network access.{{error}}
